name: Product Scout
focus: Discover products with real EU/Spain potential
summary: No challenger clearly beats Kit Muda Cero. Fresh scan adds three evidence-backed WATCH candidates: dog car seat cover/hammock, compression packing cubes, and foldable windshield sunshade umbrella. Their product risk is lower than electronics, but EU dropshipping cost/SLA still needs supplier validation.
scoring_note: 0-100 composite of recent demand evidence, retail price fit, visual demo, likely margin, saturation, logistics, returns and regulatory complexity. Unknown supplier cost is penalized.

shortlist.name: Kit Muda Cero
shortlist.demand_evidence: Pet Hair Remover Mitt is active on VelocitySpy September 2026 with 745.3K tracked views; reusable pet-hair rollers are currently listed in Spain around €20.58 plus shipping.
risks: blind EU fulfillment not yet verified
shortlist.next: Supplier & Margin: verify one-EU-warehouse landed cost and blind dropshipping for the full kit.

shortlist.name: Dog car seat cover / hammock
shortlist.demand_evidence: VelocitySpy lists Dog Car Seat Cover as an active September 2026 pet product. Spanish/EU retail references show €39.99 at Deterrajaras and €59.95 for KONG at Medpets.
shortlist.next: Supplier & Margin: find EU-stock 600D/mesh-window version under landed-cost threshold; Customer Voice: mine fit and waterproofing complaints.

shortlist.name: Pet grooming vacuum kit
shortlist.demand_evidence: VelocitySpy September 2026 ranks Pet Grooming Vacuum Kit active with 933.8K tracked views.
shortlist.next: Compliance + Supplier: only advance if EU conformity package and returns economics are verified.

shortlist.name: Compression packing cubes set
shortlist.demand_evidence: Current EU retail validates a €35-60 category: Travel Dude 7pc €49.99 with 1-2 day Spain delivery, Thule €44.95, Samsonite €60.
shortlist.next: Competitor Watch: quantify generic vs branded saturation; Supplier: search EU-stock 4-7pc set with compression zipper and landed cost allowing >60% gross margin.

shortlist.name: Foldable windshield sunshade umbrella
shortlist.demand_evidence: VelocitySpy September 2026 lists Automatic Car Windshield Sunshade as rising with 58.2K tracked views. Current EU listings range from €25.58 on Fruugo ES to €52.70 at 3Wliners.
shortlist.next: Supplier: verify EU stock and dimensions; Customer Voice: focus on fit, handle interference and durability.

shortlist.name: Reusable pet-hair roller
shortlist.demand_evidence: Multiple fresh Fruugo ES listings remain in stock around €20.58-21.58; strongest role is as a bundle component rather than standalone due sub-€25 ticket.
shortlist.next: Keep as Kit Muda Cero component, not primary standalone offer.

shortlist.name: Portable pet water bottle
shortlist.demand_evidence: VelocitySpy September 2026 shows 547.9K tracked views and 2 sellers in its snapshot.
shortlist.next: Only revisit if EU supplier enables differentiated bundle or unusually low landed cost.

shortlist.name: Pet deodorizing cleaning gloves
shortlist.demand_evidence: VelocitySpy September 2026 shows 786.4K tracked views. SHEIN Spain lists variants around €8.68 with current reviews.
shortlist.next: Consider only as upsell or bundle consumable.

shortlist.name: Handheld vacuum sealer
shortlist.demand_evidence: Visual before/after remains strong, but this cycle found no verified EU dropshipping source strong enough to remove prior concerns.
shortlist.next: Do not promote until EU stock and conformity evidence are verified.

shortlist.name: 3D printed cat wall bed
shortlist.demand_evidence: VelocitySpy shows 3D Printed Cat Bed rising with 404.2K tracked views, but current EU examples are above target price and several are unavailable/backordered.
shortlist.next: Kill for current model; revisit only if compact EU-produced version appears under €100 retail.

events.title: Fresh trend scan completed
events.detail: September 2026 pet and car snapshots rechecked; pet grooming vacuum remains high-velocity but high-risk, while dog car seat covers and windshield sunshades offer lower-regulation alternatives.

events.title: Retail price bands validated
events.detail: Dog car seat covers show viable €39.99-59.95 mainstream references; compression packing cubes cluster around €35-60; windshield umbrella listings span roughly €25.58-52.70.

events.title: Shortlist updated
events.detail: Leader unchanged. Dog car seat cover/hammock moves to #2 WATCH; compression packing cubes and windshield sunshade enter the top five. No new candidate clears PROMOTE without supplier economics.
